title: Registering Devices with the ZPA IdP Username

blocks.text: You can register a device in the Zscaler Admin Console with the username entered for Private Access (ZPA) authentication instead of the username that is used for enrollment in the app.
To register a device with the Private Access IdP username:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Advanced Settings > App Supportability.
Select Register device with ZPA IdP Username.
